messages:
aisha: Hey team — invoice INV-2026-032 for Acme looks off. It has a full reserved commit line plus a separate prorate for the same commit period. Can someone check?
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-032 generated for account acme-inc. Total $17,048. PDF: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-032 (auto-note)
tom: Can you paste the invoice lines that look duplicated?
marta: pinging @jae from billing ops to help reconcile.
aisha: Pasted snippet below — cropped for brevity:
```
LineItem: RESERVED_COMMIT   Period: 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31   Amount: $10,000   CommitID: rwd-commit-78
LineItem: RESERVED_COMMIT_PRORATE   Period: 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-15   Amount: $4,838
LineItem: OVERAGE_BURST   Period: 2026-03-16 to 2026-03-31   Amount: $2,210
```
But the commit change occurred on 2026-03-15 so we shouldn't have both the full commit and the prorate for the same seats.
jae: digging in usage logs now. I see the commit change event processed at 2026-03-15T04:12:23Z. Billing job for March ran twice due to a retry window and we re-inserted prorate without voiding the prior full-line. Looks like a de-dupe/idempotency hole in the proration path.
tom: OK — root cause seems clear. Short-term fix: issue a credit memo for the duplicate prorate and update invoice. Long-term: add idempotency key to proration job and prevent reprocessing historical lines.
aisha: Amount for duplicate prorate is $4,838 — we need finance approval to issue a credit > $1k. Also need to confirm this didn't trigger an incorrect SLA-credit calculation for dedicated capacity (customer asked about SLA credits).
sasha: Approved to proceed with credit memo and customer notification. Please include note that SLA metrics unaffected; this was billing duplication.
billing-bot: Credit memo creation requires support ticket number.
tom: Ticket created: BLG-3297 — reconciliation for INV-2026-032.
billing-bot: Created credit memo CM-2026-0112 for $4,838 against INV-2026-032. Status: pending-post.
jae: I'll enqueue a hotfix to add idempotency to the proration lambda and add an extra check that reserved commit lines with overlapping periods are collapsed. Target deploy: 2026-03-25 AM.
marta: Once credit posts, can we update the invoice PDF and ping the account rep to notify Acme?
jae: Yes — I'll update invoice and DM @account-rep to send the note after CM posts.
aisha: Thanks all. Leaving here for tracking: BLG-3297 / CM-2026-0112.
marta: quick follow-up — do we need to check other accounts with commit changes in March?
tom: Good call. I'll run a query for commit_change_date between 2026-03-01 and 2026-03-31 to find potentially impacted invoices and share results in BLG-3297.
aisha: :thumbsup:
